1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One circuit, one gate and a long repair interval; learn rewiring and cover.
1.natural_language: Recover the archive case and return to the exit unseen. Rewire matching unlocked circuits in the overlay, then operate reachable wall switches. The attendant restores a dark archive and operates the service gate relay. Alcoves provide cover. The overlay does not stop the building.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Same building, but a shorter darkness interval and wider patrol sight require a timed return.
2.natural_language: Recover the archive case and return to the exit unseen. Rewire matching unlocked circuits in the overlay, then operate reachable wall switches. The attendant restores a dark archive and operates the service gate relay. Alcoves provide cover. The overlay does not stop the building.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Two color circuits: opening the first gate enables access to the second circuit; retain the route while planning darkness.
3.natural_language: Recover the archive case and return to the exit unseen. Rewire matching unlocked circuits in the overlay, then operate reachable wall switches. The attendant restores a dark archive and operates the service gate relay. Alcoves provide cover. The overlay does not stop the building.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Three circuits and mutually interlocked gates: each opening changes the return route and makes opposite-side switches necessary.
4.natural_language: Recover the archive case and return to the exit unseen. Rewire matching unlocked circuits in the overlay, then operate reachable wall switches. The attendant restores a dark archive and operates the service gate relay. Alcoves provide cover. The overlay does not stop the building. Opening any gate closes the others; each side has a switch.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Interlocked route plus a pickup light alarm: taking the case changes the safe escape timing even inside the archive.
5.natural_language: Recover the archive case and return to the exit unseen. Rewire matching unlocked circuits in the overlay, then operate reachable wall switches. The attendant restores a dark archive and operates the service gate relay. Alcoves provide cover. The overlay does not stop the building. Opening any gate closes the others; each side has a switch. Taking the case turns the archive light on.

simplified.summary: Click a trigger then an output; hold movement buttons and click use/hide/take controls.

full.summary: Drag a circuit wire between ports; hold arrow keys and use E, Space and F in the scene.
